findings.description: Task 2.2 extracts RUN_ID_RE and parse_run_id into skills/shared/artifact_paths.py without updating the regex pattern to match collision suffixes (e.g. -2, -3). Design D8 and Task 4.1 specify that when directory collisions occur, a suffix is appended and assert that the suffixed name still satisfies parse_run_id so retention keeps counting it. Without updating RUN_ID_RE to match optional collision suffixes, parse_run_id will raise a ValueError on suffixed directories, causing list_active_runs() to silently skip them during retention scans.
findings.resolution: Update Task 2.1 and Task 2.2 to modify RUN_ID_RE and parse_run_id in skills/shared/artifact_paths.py to support an optional trailing collision count suffix (e.g. (?:-(\d+))?), ensuring suffixed directories satisfy parse_run_id and are correctly counted and managed by retention scans.
